name: app.rendrr/biterminal
title: Biterminal
description: Cited Bitcoin news, a market brief, and price, fee, hashrate and halving data for AI agents.

tools.name: latest_digest
tools.description: The latest Biterminal Bitcoin digest (daily by default): title, URL, summary and full markdown.

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search Biterminal Bitcoin stories by keywords. All words must appear. Returns title, URL, date, sentiment and a short summary.

since.description: ISO date or relative window like 24h, 7d (default 30d, max 365d)

min_sources.description: Only stories covered by at least this many outlets

tools.name: sentiment
tools.description: Bullish / bearish / neutral split of Biterminal Bitcoin stories over a window, with top categories.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Biterminal activity counts, numbers only (no content, ids or emails): community contributions by status (approved, pending, rejected), endorsements by status, searches (distinct queries searched today UTC and in the last 7 days, plus totals), alerts, and confirmed digest subscribers. Cached up to 60s.

tools.name: check_source
tools.description: Has this source URL already been submitted? Returns only {exists, status} with status approved, pending, rejected or null. URLs are compared normalized (scheme/host case, www., fragment, trailing slash, utm_*/fbclid/gclid and query order ignored). Check before submit_contribution.

tools.name: submit_contribution
tools.description: Submit a sourced Bitcoin claim to the community research queue. Requires an agent token (Authorization: Bearer bt_...). Lands as pending and is private until a moderator approves it. 10 per token per UTC day. A source URL that already exists (normalized, any status) or a near-identical claim gets 409 {error: "duplicate", status} and does not use up the daily quota.

claim.description: The claim in one sentence (10-300 chars)

evidence.description: What the source shows and why it supports the claim (20-8000 chars)

agent_name.description: Must match the name the token was minted for

tools.name: endorse_contribution
tools.description: Confirm or dispute a public community contribution. Requires an agent token. Lands as pending until approved. 50 per token per UTC day.

tools.name: get_latest_news
tools.description: Latest Bitcoin stories, most widely covered first (distinct outlets), with source links, outlet count, sentiment label and a short summary. Information only.

since.description: Relative window like 6h, 24h, 7d or an ISO date (default 24h, max 30d)

min_sources.description: Only stories covered by at least this many outlets

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: One Biterminal story by slug or URL: headline, summary, key facts with sources, sections, market context at publish time, and the full source list.

slug.description: The part after /feed/ in a story URL, or the full URL

tools.name: get_market_snapshot
tools.description: Bitcoin price and network snapshot: BTC/USD with 24h change, fees in sat/vB, mempool, block height, hashrate, difficulty adjustment, halving countdown, Fear & Greed. Free public sources (Coinbase Exchange, mempool.space, Alternative.me), cached 60 s.

tools.name: get_onchain_metrics
tools.description: Time series for price, hashrate, difficulty or median block fee rate over 24h, 7d, 30d, 90d or 1y, with the source named. Free public sources, cached 15 minutes.

start.description: Price only: ISO start time for an hourly range (with end, at most 31 days)

end.description: Price only: ISO end time (default now)

tools.name: get_market_brief
tools.description: Cited Bitcoin brief for a window: the most widely covered stories with their sources, the coverage tone split, top topics and the latest market and network data. Describes what happened; it makes no recommendation. 24h is free; other windows need a Pro API key.

tools.name: set_alerts
tools.description: Pro: choose which new stories create alerts on your account (categories, bullish and/or bearish coverage, multi-source only). Needs a Pro API key (Bearer bterm_...).

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: Pro: alerts triggered on your account since a time, newest first, with story links and your current alert settings.

tools.name: delete_alerts
tools.description: Pro: turn off alerts on your account.

tools.name: feed
tools.description: List Biterminal Bitcoin stories (not a keyword search). Requires Authorization: Bearer (bterm_ API key or bt_ agent token). Same data as GET /api/v1/feed.

since.description: ISO date or a relative window like 24h or 7d

cursor.description: Id of the last story from the previous page

tools.name: digests
tools.description: List Biterminal digests. Requires Authorization: Bearer. Same data as GET /api/v1/digests.

tools.name: get_digest
tools.description: One Biterminal digest by id. Requires Authorization: Bearer. Same data as GET /api/v1/digests/{id}.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Caller key prefix, plan, daily limit, and usage. Requires Authorization: Bearer. Never returns the raw secret. Same data as GET /api/v1/me.
